label: Membrane, excitability and signalling
text: BI.O.A2.2 Membrane, excitability and signalling. A lipid bilayer sets an inside; transport is passive or pumped. The resting membrane potential is owned here. The Nernst equation that gives each ion's equilibrium potential is owned by chemistry (uses CH.O.A3.3). The action potential is owned here as an excitable-membrane claim. CONTESTED: alternative home MS.O.A2. Signalling covers receptor, second messenger and response. Specificity is binding, not a new force.

warrant.standard: Perturbation with controls; imaging with stated resolution; replication across cell lines
warrant.defeaters: Fixation artefact; overexpression artefact; cell-line misidentification
